$comment: 每月依賴檢查用：已經看過、但這次不升的決定。deferredLatest 記下當時審視的版本，PyPI 一超過它就自動恢復提醒。

pytest.reason: maintainer test suite baseline; floor raised to 9.0.3 (lowest release clear of CVE-2025-71176) on 2026-11-22; see DECISIONS

pytest-asyncio.reason: Retain the >=0.23 floor across Python 3.10-3.14; tested on 1.5.0 (clean Python 3.14 venv on 2026-11-21: dev_check and test_product green, fork regressions 812 passed with one local timing-budget flake; CI run 44870503353 green on Python 3.10-3.14 with this version).

httpx.reason: Retain the >=0.24 test-client floor: no known advisory on the floor (OSV, 2026-11-21) and no fork need for a newer API. Tested on 0.28.1 (clean Python 3.14 venv on 2026-11-21: dev_check and test_product green, fork regressions 812 passed with one local timing-budget flake; CI run 44870503353 green on Python 3.10-3.14 with this version).

ruff.reason: Retain the >=0.9 linter floor: no known advisory on the floor (OSV, 2026-11-22) and no gate needs a newer rule. 0.17.5 and 0.17.6 release notes read: no stable rule added to E9/F; the two pyflakes changes (F823 false-negative fix, F841 ignoring __traceback_hide__) change nothing here. Tested on 0.17.6 (clean Python 3.14 venv, 2026-11-22): dev_check green, and ruff E9,F over the whole tree gives the same 15858 diagnostics as 0.17.4.

pydantic.reason: Retain the current latest-tracking range above the raised floor. 2.14.4 release notes read: fixes and JSON Schema corrections only; lib/config_model.py uses BaseModel, Field(default_factory) and model_validate, none of which changed. Tested on 2.14.4 (clean Python 3.14 venv on 2026-11-22: dev_check and test_product green, fork regressions 818 passed with one local timing-budget flake). The floor was raised to 2.4.0 (lowest release clear of CVE-2024-3772) on 2026-11-22; see DECISIONS.

jsonschema.reason: Retain upstream >=4.20 floor: no known advisory on the floor (OSV, 2026-11-21) and upstream has not moved it. Tested on 4.26.0 (clean Python 3.14 venv on 2026-11-21: dev_check and test_product green, fork regressions 812 passed with one local timing-budget flake; CI run 44870503353 green on Python 3.10-3.14 with this version).

python-dotenv.reason: Floor raised to >=1.2.2 on 2026-11-22: the old >=1.0 floor sat inside CVE-2026-28684 (fixed in 1.2.2), and a lower bound must not fall inside a known-vulnerable range, whether or not this repo calls the affected API. Not raised further because 1.2.2 is the lowest release without a known advisory (OSV, 2026-11-22) and the floor is a compatibility promise. Tested on 1.2.4 (clean Python 3.14 venv on 2026-11-22: dev_check and test_product green, fork regressions 818 passed with one local timing-budget flake) and the dotenv-importing tests on 1.2.2.

Pillow.reason: upstream runtime compatibility floor; tracking calesthio/OpenMontage baseline

numpy.reason: Retain upstream >=1.24 floor; 2.5.5 needs Python >=3.12, so 3.10/3.11 resolve an older release inside the range. Tested on 2.5.5 (clean Python 3.14 venv on 2026-11-21: dev_check and test_product green, fork regressions 812 passed with one local timing-budget flake; CI run 44870503353 green on Python 3.10-3.14 with this version).

requests.reason: Floor raised to >=2.33.0 on 2026-11-21 (clears CVE-2024-35195, CVE-2024-47081, CVE-2026-25645); not raised further because 2.33.0 is the lowest release without a known advisory and the floor is a compatibility promise. Tested on 2.34.2 (clean Python 3.14 venv on 2026-11-21: dev_check and test_product green, fork regressions 812 passed with one local timing-budget flake; CI run 44870503353 green on Python 3.10-3.14 with this version) and the requests-importing test files on 2.33.0.

google-auth.reason: Retain upstream >=2.0 floor: no known advisory on the floor (OSV, 2026-11-22). CHANGELOG 2.62.2-2.63.1 read: mTLS rotation, Firebase token checks, Cloud Run SPIFFE, regional access boundary gating and universe_domain in jwt credentials; tools/google_credentials.py only calls service_account.Credentials.from_service_account_file and refresh(Request()), which are untouched. Tested on 2.63.1 (clean Python 3.14 venv on 2026-11-22: dev_check and test_product green, fork regressions 818 passed with one local timing-budget flake); the import surface resolves, but no credential-backed refresh was run.

google-genai.reason: Retain upstream >=1.0.0 floor: no known advisory on the floor (OSV, 2026-11-22). Release notes 3.0.0-3.6.1 read. Two 3.0.0 breaking changes reach this repo: (1) API-key clients default to v1 instead of v1beta - on 3.6.1 the SDK sends Lyria to /v1/interactions and Gemini image generation to /v1/models/*:generateContent (recorded offline with a mock transport), and whether v1 serves those models is not verified; (2) generate_videos is refused locally for API-key clients, which veo_video.py already blocks before calling. Offline evidence only (clean Python 3.14 venv on 2026-11-22: dev_check and test_product green, fork regressions 818 passed with one local timing-budget flake); live Lyria/Imagen/Veo validation is queued in ROADMAP.

openai.reason: Retain upstream >=2.44.0 Videos API floor: no known advisory on the floor (OSV, 2026-11-22). Release notes 3.49.0-3.57.0 read: additive API surface (typed async function tools, Live, Managed Agents, new model identifiers) and no breaking change; images.generate/edit, audio.speech streaming, videos.create_and_poll and videos.download_content still resolve on 3.57.0. Tested on 3.57.0 (clean Python 3.14 venv on 2026-11-22: dev_check and test_product green, fork regressions 818 passed with one local timing-budget flake); live TTS, image and Sora calls are not validated.

fastapi.reason: Retain upstream >=0.110 runtime floor: no known advisory on the floor (OSV, 2026-11-22). Release notes 0.162.3-0.165.0 read: 0.162.6 drops Python 3.10, so 3.10 resolves 0.162.5 inside the range; the rest is dependency-cleanup fixes, a parameter-extraction refactor and opt-in limits (Depends max_concurrency, request body size, form parsing) that backlot's GET-only server does not use. Tested on 0.165.0 (clean Python 3.14 venv on 2026-11-22: dev_check and test_product green, fork regressions 818 passed with one local timing-budget flake; tests/backlot/test_server.py runs against it).

uvicorn.reason: Retain upstream >=0.29 floor: no known advisory on the floor (OSV, 2026-11-21). No test imports uvicorn; on 0.54.0 a manual smoke served backlot (/api/health, /api/projects, /) on 2026-11-21, alongside clean Python 3.14 venv on 2026-11-21: dev_check and test_product green, fork regressions 812 passed with one local timing-budget flake; CI run 44870503353 green on Python 3.10-3.14 with this version.

watchfiles.reason: Retain upstream >=0.21 floor: no known advisory on the floor (OSV, 2026-11-21). No test imports watchfiles; on 1.3.0 a manual awatch smoke saw a file change on Windows on 2026-11-21, alongside clean Python 3.14 venv on 2026-11-21: dev_check and test_product green, fork regressions 812 passed with one local timing-budget flake; CI run 44870503353 green on Python 3.10-3.14 with this version.

torch.reason: Retain upstream GPU floor; latest PyPI versions alone do not establish a compatible torch/torchaudio/torchvision and Windows CUDA combination; GPU model inference is not validated in this review.

torchaudio.reason: Retain upstream GPU floor; audio extension and torch compatibility must be checked as a matched Windows/CUDA set with real inference, not independent latest versions.

torchvision.reason: Retain upstream GPU floor; defer adoption until matched torch/Windows CUDA and basicsr face_restore/upscale compatibility are validated; upstream PR #875 remains a documented re-review trigger.

websockets.reason: Retain upstream >=14.0 floor; defer baseline adoption until Eleven v4 Turbo and realtime transport behavior is checked on 17.4, beyond the prior 17.3 evidence.

certifi.reason: Retain the upstream security floor 2026.10.19: no known advisory on the floor (OSV, 2026-11-22). Bundle diffs read: 2026.10.23 drops the two eMudhra emSign roots, 2026.11.20 drops Buypass Class 2/3, QuoVadis Root CA 1 G3/3 G3 and Certigna Root CA; nothing is added. On 2026.11.20 a TLS handshake with the certifi bundle against the 99 https hosts named in tools/, lib/ and backlot/ gave 96 ok, 0 verification failures and 3 names that do not resolve (2026-11-22, one network). Also clean Python 3.14 venv on 2026-11-22: dev_check and test_product green, fork regressions 818 passed with one local timing-budget flake.

pythainlp.reason: Retain upstream >=5.0 floor (new with the Thai caption work); the Thai caption tests pass on 5.4.0, which is the version installed for review.
